finding: No emphasis or spacing hierarchy: every surface is the same radius-20 white card, same soft shadow, same bold ~17pt title, at the same ~12px gap. Nothing ranks. a02 stacks 7 identical cards (the primary Signals readout looks as important as 'Delete recording'); a08 stacks ~12. Long screens have no 24/32/48 section tiers, so the eye is never led to a focal point — reads as an even mat of equal tiles.
recommendation: 3-tier surface system (hero card > secondary card > inset grouped row) + spacing tiers: ~16 intra-group, 32–48 between top-level sections. This is the single highest-leverage fix.

finding: Several near-greens (selection #54B492, checkInGreen/mood-4 #5FB36E, mood-5 #2E8B57) encode brand + primary-CTA + on-toggle + chip-selection + 'Installed' status + mood-value all at once. checkInGreen == the mood-4 bead EXACTLY, so action and data literally share a hue. On a08 alone green is the status dot, every toggle, selected chips, a checkmark, and the Save card. No green element reads as one definite state.
recommendation: Split into semantic tokens: green = primary action / on-state ONLY. Give 'selected' a neutral tint or border+check (not a green fill). Let the mood ramp own mood; never reuse the CTA green as data.

finding: Content groups use web/Material card ELEVATION (borderless white + drop shadow + r20 + bold title INSIDE, no separators) instead of iOS grouped-table grammar (shadowless inset toned fills, gray caption headers OUTSIDE the group, hairline separators). a08 reproduces the STRUCTURE of Settings.app as floating web cards — contradicting DESIGN.md §Layout's native grouped-List intent. Biggest single native-feel break.
recommendation: Convert settings/detail screens to inset grouped-table grammar; reserve the elevated card for genuine hero content. Aligns with the app's own grouped-List decision.

finding: The same 3 signals are charted 3–5 different ways on ONE screen: overlapping bubbles (breakdown), glyph strips (weekday), beaker/thermometer gauges (averages), dot-grid heatmap (rhythm), progress bars (connections). Strongest 'templated/AI-assembled' tell in the set. Energy is clean yellow in the glyph row but muddy olive in the gauge. Overlapping bubbles imply Venn intersections that don't exist and crush the 8%/13% labels.
recommendation: Commit to 1–2 marks reused across all Insights cards with a shared scale/legend; make energy one yellow everywhere; replace the breakdown bubbles with a stacked bar or donut.

finding: Filled and outline glyphs mixed at one hierarchy level. The signal trio is filled-tree + filled-bolt + OUTLINE-aperture on every screen, so focus perpetually recedes beside mood/energy. a02 card-header icons alternate: filled red heart, outline moon, outline thermometer, solid capsule — four weights/fills; 'Transcript' has no icon at all.
recommendation: One fill treatment per hierarchy tier: give the aperture equal weight to tree/bolt (or lighten all three). Unify header icons to one style, one stroke weight, one muted tint; icon every header or none.

finding: iOS status bar rendered on only 5 of 8 frames (a01/a02/a07 omit it) → the med bar occupies the status-bar band there and its clearance vs clock/battery is untested. The med bar floats ABOVE the large title using identical card chrome, breaking the iOS large-title contract and reading as another content tile rather than global chrome.
recommendation: Render every frame with the same status-bar inset; verify med-bar clearance on device. Make the med bar visually distinct pinned chrome (thinner/tinted) so it stops competing as content.

finding: Selectable chips ~26–36pt tall, the ⋯ affordance 21pt, +/^ header buttons ~28pt — all below the 44×44pt minimum. a03's Emotions grid packs ~24 chips on ~8px gaps, so both target size and inter-target spacing are marginal.
recommendation: Raise chip/icon-button hit areas to >=44pt via hitSlop / .contentShape padding (without inflating the visual pill); increase inter-chip spacing in the chip grids.

finding: The giant green ring is an empty container ('donut of emptiness') holding only 3 small pills, with a large dead gap up to the top-pinned title — reads as decorative bulk, neither progress ring nor record button. a05 strands the prompt card the same way AND carries two redundant progress indicators (fill bar + 5 dots) for one carousel.
recommendation: Shrink the ring to hug its contents or give it a real job (record level / prompt progress); tighten the title-to-control vertical rhythm; drop one of the duplicate carousel indicators.

finding: The first-text-in-card slot plays 4–5 type roles with no rule — Semi Bold 17 title vs Regular 10/11 eyebrow vs Semi Bold 15 vs Bold 24. On a03/a07 some cards lead with an eyebrow where siblings lead with a bold title, so the primary scanning anchor drifts screen to screen.
recommendation: Fix one card-title role (Semi Bold 17); make the uppercase eyebrow a separate, consistently-applied sub-role — never the card's lead element where a title is expected.

finding: Card metrics cluster into two disagreeing families: 'detail' (a02/a03: inter-card gap 10, top-pad 12, internal 8–10) vs 'browse' (a07/a08: 12 / 14 / 12), with a04 (gap 6) an outlier. The dominant 14 card padding is never reconciled with the dominant 12 gap. a02 alone carries four different card paddings → ragged edges within one screen.
recommendation: Define one spacing module (e.g. card pad 14, internal gap 12, inter-card by tier) and apply it across all screens; kill the per-screen variants.

finding: Two worlds share no margin rhythm: dense card-stacks (a01–a03, a07, a08) vs sparse centered clusters floating in ~70% empty canvas (a04–a06). No common margin, baseline, or max-density, so the flow reads as two different apps.
recommendation: Define one page grid — margins, section spacing, max content density — and make the sparse 'moment' screens honor the same margins/rhythm as the dense ones.

finding: Chips are not one component family: heights 18/26/36/38, radii 0/14/18/999, paddings 5/10 vs 5/8 vs 10/18, and two shapes (a01 square r=0 display chips vs pills everywhere else).
recommendation: Define one chip component: one height, one radius (pill), one padding; the a01 display chips should either adopt the pill shape or be visibly a different, named element.

finding: Selection is signaled by two different hues (green vs medication purple), so 'selected' is not one readable signal. A single choice is expressed three different ways (a08), two of them inside one card. The dashed-outline style is overloaded to mean three unrelated things.
recommendation: One selection signal app-wide; one control pattern per choice; reserve dashed-outline for a single meaning.

finding: An expanded white day card and a collapsed sage-green card carry the identical 'GREAT · MON' label back-to-back in two different greens → reads as a duplicate/bug. Mood-disc encoding is inconsistent (bare tree on the top row, filled discs below); the selected day reads as disabled; green-tinted surfaces on the green ground have weak edge definition (green-on-green).
recommendation: Clearly differentiate expanded vs collapsed states; make mood-disc encoding consistent across rows; strengthen tinted-surface edges against the sage ground.

finding: Switch tint is the brand teal-green rather than the system control green; detached pills are used where iOS uses a single unified segmented control.
recommendation: Use system green for switches; unify multi-option rows to a segmented control.

finding: Medication-purple is reused for the audio player, diluting a color the system otherwise reserves exclusively for medication.
recommendation: Give the audio player a neutral control color; keep purple = medication only.

finding: The mini signal bars under GREAT/CHARGED/SHARP are ~2px hairlines — too thin to convey a value, so they read as underline decoration rather than data.
recommendation: Give the bars real height/weight, or replace with the glyph strip used elsewhere.

finding: Dashed-outline locked/placeholder cards are a web/Figma idiom with no iOS equivalent; a06 success screen is unbalanced (centered checkmark vs bottom-pinned Done with a large empty gap).
recommendation: Use iOS locked/empty-state patterns; balance the a06 composition.
